correctness.rationale: All four furtherness weight cases are exact. The order complexes are subgraphs of the edge subdivision, so H1 injects between stages and higher-degree groups vanish. Vertex-root stage two is a star; edge-root stage two is a double star with c_e independent triangle cycles. Component/rank counts prove all formulas over Z and therefore every field. Freshly extracted verify.py passed 14,946 roots on 1,100 connected graphs plus fifty roots on named examples; these finite tests do not replace the proof. The nonhomotopy claim invokes the credited Stong-core classification.
